title: The next episode is one click away | Vela
description:
Vela shows the next episode’s number and title, then starts it with one click. This recording uses the explicitly named Open Cinema Stories demo library, assembled from licensed Blender clips. The dark first background is the real paused end-of-episode frame; the actual Next Episode control is magnified for readability.

Vela for macOS · Beta. Local files work without a Jellyfin server. Jellyfin features require your server; episode prompts depend on available chapters/segments and metadata. VLC is the default local playback engine; compatibility depends on the file.
Discover Vela: https://ralleur.github.io/Vela/
